CFML Language Reference: Functions

ReplaceNoCase

Replaces the first occurrence, or every occurrence, of a substring with another string, without regard to case.

Category

String functions

Syntax

ReplaceNoCase(string, substring1, substring2 [, scope ])

Parameters

string
The string to work on.
substring1
The text to look for, in any mix of upper and lower case.
substring2
The replacement text (used exactly as given).
scope
Optional. "ONE" (the default) or "ALL".

Returns

The string with the replacements made.

Usage

Handy for highlighting a search word in results, whatever case the visitor typed it in. Note that the replacement text is inserted as written, so the original capitalization of the matched text is lost; use REReplaceNoCase with a back reference if you need to keep it.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Text = "ColdFusion? coldfusion! COLDFUSION...">
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Original: #Text#</P>
<P>ONE: #ReplaceNoCase(Text, "coldfusion", "KoldFusion")#</P>
<P>ALL: #ReplaceNoCase(Text, "coldfusion", "KoldFusion", "ALL")#</P>
<P>Replace (case-sensitive) ALL: #Replace(Text, "coldfusion", "KoldFusion", "ALL")#</P>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

Replace, REReplaceNoCase, FindNoCase, ReplaceList
